mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can potentiate sympathomimetic effects when combined with tranylcypromine (an irreversible MAOI), increasing risk of hypertensive crisis and CNS stimulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if brimonidine is necessary, monitor blood pressure closely and consider alternative ophthalmic agents (e.g., beta-blockers, prostaglandin analogs).
